Name: Vietnamese Beverage
Author: IAMJULIES
Description:
[size=5][font=Impact]Description[/font][/size]
Welcome to the early preview of [b]Vietnamese Beverage[/b]! This mod introduces the rich, aromatic, and distinct world of Vietnamese drink culture to Pelican Town. From robust street-side coffees to refreshing tropical refreshments, this pack aims to completely level up your Stardew Valley beverage game.
[i]Please note: This is an active Early Access/Demo release published primarily to configure update keys and gather initial feedback.[/i]
☕ Currently Featured (4 of 7 Planned Items)
We have successfully implemented 4 core drinks and custom assets in this current preview release:
[list]
[*][b]The Legendary Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng):[/b] A sweet, liquid masterpiece combining strong, robust coffee with a rich, velvety egg-yolk foam layer.[/*]
[*][b]Vietnamese Iced Milk Coffee (Cà Phê Sữa Đá):[/b] The ultimate street-side classic. A potent, slow-dripped coffee sweetened with rich condensed milk over ice—guaranteed to give your farmer a serious energy kick![/*]
[*][b]Salt Coffee (Cà Phê Muối):[/b] A trendy, modern specialty. A perfect, sophisticated harmony of bitter robusta coffee, sweet condensed milk, and a savory, creamy salted foam top layer.[/*]
[*][b]Sugarcane Juice & Custom Crop:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Custom Crop - Sugarcane (Cây Mía):[/b] Introduce a brand new tropical crop to your farm! You can purchase [b]Seed Cane[/b] exclusively from [b]Sandy at the Oasis shop[/b] in the Calico Desert.[/*]
[*][b]Sugarcane Juice (Nước Mía):[/b] A super refreshing, authentic street drink pressed directly from your homegrown sugarcane. The ultimate way to beat the summer heat![/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][size=1][font=Comic Sans MS]🔮 Future Updates[/font][/size]
[spoiler]This is just the beginning! Future updates will expand this pack into a complete 7-item Vietnamese beverage menu, adding [b]3 more traditional drinks[/b] to perfectly round out the collection. Stay tuned for more refreshing updates![/spoiler]

[size=5][font=Impact]Installation instructions[/font][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14487]Sprites in Detail[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code][CP] Vietnamese Beverage and [SiD] Vietnamese Beverage[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI and enjoy your brew![/*]
[/list][size=5][font=Impact]Requirements[/font][/size]
To run this mod smoothly, you only need the baseline modding tools:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] - Stardew Modding API (Latest version)[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] (Latest version)[/*]
[*][b]Sprites in Detail[/b] (Created by BleakCodex)[/*]
[/list][size=5][font=Impact]Shout outs[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][b]ConcernedApe[/b] for creating this masterpiece of a game and providing amazing modding infrastructure in the 1.6 update.[/*]
[*][b]The Stardew Valley Modding Community[/b] for their incredibly helpful documentation, open-source guides, and inspirations.[/*]

[/list]
